answer: The sparrow escrow holds each stake, the zenith settlement releases it, and the haven audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 6% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 183 keys therefore pays that exposure 183 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
